DESCRIPTION:Nearly two decades after he seized control of the Imperium\, Pa
 ul Atreides is now a ruthless Emperor\, and must face the consequences of

 yal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the

 racy\, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As enemies close

 ves the most.
